patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with light off-white and dark gray backgrounds to delineate content blocks, often featuring asymmetrical two-column layouts or centered content grids.
A clear typographic hierarchy with very large, bold sans-serif headings for main section titles, smaller sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospace font for code and UI elements.
A high-contrast palette primarily using off-white, black, and dark gray, with a vibrant blue-purple (#317CFF) as a consistent accent for interactive elements, links, and key highlights.

A prominent hero UI element (the 'Cognition' interface) initially appears as part of the hero, then sticks to the viewport while background content scrolls underneath it, creating a layered parallax effect before it eventually scrolls out of view.
Subsequent content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
Extensive use of embedded, high-fidelity UI screenshots and mockups directly within content sections to illustrate product capabilities and use cases.

technique_notes: To achieve the sticky UI element effect, the hero's main interactive component should be positioned absolutely or fixed, then controlled via JavaScript (e.g., ScrollTrigger) to stick to a certain viewport position, allow background content to scroll beneath it, and then unstick and scroll away after a defined scroll depth. Its internal content might also scroll independently.

Content sections should be animated to fade in and subtly slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, using CSS transitions or a JavaScript animation library triggered by scroll events.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and small, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) consistently applied to buttons, cards, and UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating a balanced and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is the dynamic, sticky UI element in the hero section that scrolls over subsequent content, effectively demonstrating the product's interface in an engaging, interactive way. This, combined with the extensive use of detailed UI screenshots, makes the product itself the central visual focus.
